original.target_description: Study 2 medical students/residents: target race × false-belief interaction on pain ratings, adjusted for age, gender and medical cohort.

n.sample_role: medical students and residents; final eligible sample 222, exact analytic n for adjusted interaction not explicitly printed
n.exclusions: Excluded nonwhite participants and participants not native-English-speaking and/or American; missing demographic covariates reduce analytic sample.
n.quote: Some participants did not report age, gender, and/or race/ethnicity and thus degrees of freedom vary across analyses.

es.quote: Results revealed only the predicted target race by false beliefs interaction [ F (1,211) = 9.56, P = 0.002, η G 2 = 0.02; Fig. 2 A ].

replication.target_description: White US-born native-English-speaking participants without medical training; authors’ post-replication report focal test.

n.sample_role: White US-born native-English-speaking participants without medical training
n.exclusions: Excluded 76 not US-born, another 5 not native-English-speaking, another 129 nonwhite; preregistered criteria.
n.quote: Replication Results: The effect is tested by regressing pain ratings on target race, false beliefs, and their interaction, controlling for age, gender, and self-ratings of pain. The interaction between target race and false beliefs yields a negative coefficient β = –0.014 (se = 0.027), but the null hypothesis of no effect cannot be rejected (F(1,496) = 0.268, p = 0.605; n = 503). The standardized effect size (Cohen’s d) is d = 0.092 (95% CI [–0.258, 0.443]).

reported_success.quote: Discussion: Given the criteria and procedure outlined above, the hypothesis of interest has not been replicated at a significance level of p < 0.05.

notes: Original and replication evaluated separately. Replication statistics are as printed in the primary authors’ post-replication report. Replication targets original Study 1 laypeople, whereas assigned original locator specifies Study 2 medical trainees. Original eligible sample 222 is not silently substituted for test-specific analytic n.
